note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 1996 Toyota T100 Factory Service Manual (RM449U). It holds the T100 4x2 as a wheeled civilian-car lead. The manual publishes the tyre size code and the W59 manual transmission option. It publishes no vehicle operating weight, no vehicle dimension table, no ground clearance and no rated engine output, so the entry is not runtime-ready. The tyre size code P215/75R15 carries a passenger type prefix, so the named size-code derivation does not parse it and the tyre width and diameter are absent.
